scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Interest Subsidy (Service Sector)
other_conditions: The enterprise must be a new micro, small, or medium enterprise.
It must operate in the service sector as listed in Annexure A & B.
The term loan must be sanctioned by a recognized bank or financial institution.
Application must be made within one year of loan disbursement or before commercial production starts.
The enterprise must remain operational for at least seven years after subsidy approval.
Compliance with pollution control measures is required.
Only one type of investment (forward integration, backward integration, diversification, or expansion) is eligible for the subsidy.
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy of up to 8% on term loans (maximum ₹35 lakh) for 7 years, with lower rates for smaller categories, and an additional 1% subsidy for registered startups in the service sector.
